about: Offers to act in basic « Initiative » (passation-pro briefs/design-agents-proactifs.md §2.1, §3.1–3.5, §3.3, §3b.4 « the same rule holds in basic, per kind », §6 row 6, §7.1, §7.3; Alex 22/11: D1 A, D2 A, D4 B; texts validated 22/11 08:53). The agent offers to DO something, not only to remind: « Je regarde les hôtels ? », « Je te mets un rappel ? », « Je cherche le trajet ? ». One offer is ONE card (`bip-offer-<id>`) with two buttons, « Oui » / « Non merci ». It may only offer what it can really do here, now: a closed list of seven kinds, the ones it can't do are neither in its tool's description nor accepted. Nothing is done and nothing costs before « Oui »; then the bridge does it itself (route, reminder, calendar: no model) or the agent gets one turn in the offer's conversation with exactly the words under « i » (search, draft, page, cart: drafts and searches only; nothing booked, paid or sent without its own card). Only the person answers. Kept in `<data>/offers.json` (0600) by bridge-rs/src/plans/offers.rs (`plans::offers`, after plans.rs). Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_offers.py and plans/offers/tests.rs (the bridge), and by the apps' OfferCard (branches plans-ios, plans-android). Additions only: an app 1.0 draws its generic Yes / No card for any unknown `bip-` card. The smart offers (§3b: any action it can do, `uses`, `later`, the passes of the day) are branch 12 (`smart-offers`); the calendar's, the Carnet's trips' and the replies due's offers made by the bridge are branch 7 (`plans-sources`).

tool.name: offer_act
tool.listed: To the person's own agents whose « Initiative » is not off (contracts/proactive: basic; smart too until branch 12 brings its free form) and that can do at least one kind here now; never to an agent other people talk to (vault.rs `others_facing`). Off, others-facing or no kind: not listed, and a call is refused.
tool.description: Says when to offer (something to come in the person's own life with a clear next step; to end a routine's, a watcher's or a trigger's turn when what it found calls for an action, rather than a question), when never (the past, a « maybe », someone else's life, what they just refused), at most 2 offers per reply, drafts and searches only (never book, pay or send: those keep their own card), then ONLY the kinds this agent can do here now, one line each, then the learning line when there is one (`learning`).

arguments.kind: one of the kinds listed for this agent (`kinds`); the enum of the schema holds only those
arguments.label: the question on the card, in the person's language, 1 to 80 characters, plain text (« Je regarde les hôtels près de Baixa ? »)
arguments.about: what it is about, 1 to 40 characters, plain text: the card's top line « {agent} propose · {about} » (« Lisbonne », « Mariage samedi »)
arguments.prompt: search, draft, page, cart: what the agent will be asked at « Oui », exactly (shown under « i »), 1 to 600 characters, plain text on one line (no markup: no <, >, `, ](, **; links in https only). Refused for route, reminder, calendar.
arguments.params: route, reminder, calendar: what the bridge will do, exactly (shown under « i »); refused for the others. A closed list of fields, kind by kind (review R3): any other field is refused « Not done: params.<field>: … » (a calendar offer never writes notes, attendees nor a calendar of its choosing). route {to (1–200), from? (1–200; default the person's home: the « Coordonnées » entry labelled home that this agent reads, plans.rs `home_of`), mode?: walking | driving | transit (default walking)} · reminder {at (« YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM » on the person's clock, or with an offset; to come), say (1–240, plain text, as the reminder will say it)} · calendar {title (1–120), start (an ISO date-time or a date, to come), end? or duration_minutes?, location? (≤ 200)}
arguments.site: cart only, required: the shop's host name (« www.decathlon.fr »)

kinds.needs: the street routing on (`[maps] streets` not « off ») and a start: `from`, or a home address in « Coordonnées » this agent reads
kinds.yes: the bridge geocodes both places (Nominatim) and asks OSRM for the time (coordinates only), then puts one Boîte line in the offer's conversation, texts.<lang>.route_done, with the map of the way attached (maps.rs, the same map card as `map_image`); not found: texts.<lang>.route_failed. 0 model.
the bridge makes a one-time routine whose words are `params.say`, at `params.at` (routines.rs `create_said`: delivered as written, no model). 0 model.

kinds.needs: a calendar it may write to: the phone's (calendar.rs `writes`), else Google Calendar's (google_calendar.rs `offered`)
kinds.yes: the bridge writes exactly the event the card shows: the phone's calendar through its queue (the phone woken by a silent push), or Google Calendar's primary calendar. This card is that write's card (`calendar_write`, critical): no other card. Not written: texts.<lang>.calendar_failed. 0 model.

kinds.needs: the web search (Hermes' `web` toolset not known off) or its own browser on
kinds.yes: one turn of the agent in the offer's conversation (`yes_note`), its reply where it is: results, nothing booked

kinds.needs: always (a mailbox's Drafts when it has one, else a ```draft block)
kinds.yes: one turn that writes drafts, never sent

kinds.example: Je te fais la liste de bagages ?
kinds.yes: one turn that makes the page

kinds.needs: payments allowed to this agent with a card of its own (card_pay.rs `shopping`: Card), its own browser on, and `site` allowed by one of its cards (cards.rs `site_allowed`: a card with no sites allows any)
kinds.yes: one turn that fills the basket up to the payment page; paying keeps its own card (« Oui, payer »)

tool.can_not: A kind it can't do now (not in its list) is refused: « Not done: you can't <what> here; don't offer it. »
tool.yes_note: The turn at « Oui » reads, hidden: « Your person said yes to your offer: « <prompt> ». Do exactly that now. Drafts only: never book, pay or send; anything like that goes through its own card. » (design §3.3)

answers_to_the_agent.made: « Offer card made: « <label> ». It waits for your person's « Oui » or « Non merci »: nothing is done before. Don't ask them again in words. »
answers_to_the_agent.refused: Every refusal starts with « Not done: » and says why in one sentence; nothing is kept, no card.

refusals.name: off
refusals.about: « Initiative » off, or an agent other people talk to
refusals.says: Not done: your person turned your suggestions off

refusals.name: kind
refusals.about: a kind not of the seven

refusals.name: can_not
refusals.about: one of the seven it can't do here now

refusals.name: plain
refusals.about: markup, a line break or an http:// link in label, about, prompt or say

refusals.name: prompt_or_params
refusals.about: a prompt for route, reminder or calendar; params for the others; either missing

refusals.name: past
refusals.about: a reminder's `at` or an event's start not to come

refusals.name: site
refusals.about: cart: no site, or one none of its cards allows

refusals.name: per_reply
refusals.about: a third offer in the same turn of the person's conversation (a plan's offers count)
refusals.says: Not done: two offers per reply

refusals.name: same

refusals.name: kind_quiet

refusals.says: Not done: your person said no thanks

refusals.name: topic_declined

refusals.says: Not done: your person said no

refusals.says: Not done: one of your cards already waits

refusals.about: unasked: 2 cards of this agent today (plans and offers together)

refusals.says: Not done: your person's agents made 4

caps.about: Help without bothering (D2 A, §3.2), the plans' own counts shared (contracts/plans `caps`): « asked » is a call in a turn of the person's own conversation (agent_tools.rs `persons_own_call`); anything else is unasked. A plan's offers shown on its card (`plan_propose.offers`) count in the reply's 2 and never as cards of their own.
caps.expires_also: a reminder's `at`, an event's start: an offer whose moment has passed expires then

learning.about: §3b.4, « la même règle vaut en basique, par sorte »: counters per agent and kind over 30 sliding days, no text kept (yes, no, expired, at).
learning.two_no_in_a_row: two « Non merci » in a row for a kind (an expiry in between breaks nothing, a « Oui » starts the series again): that kind is quiet for 30 days for this agent: out of its list, refused
learning.low_yes_rate: at least 5 offers of a kind in 30 days and less than 20 % yes (an expired one counts half a no): quiet 30 days
learning.topic: a subject (`about`, case and spaces aside) its person said « Non merci » to is not offered again for 30 days
learning.line: the agent knows: one line in its tool's description, « Your person often declines: <kinds>. Often accepts: <kinds>. » (a kind with at least 3 answers in 30 days: under a third yes, declines; two thirds or more, accepts; quiet kinds are out of the list already). It changes only when a threshold passes (the prompt cache holds).
learning.not_off: « Non merci » is never « Éteinte »: it holds for that card; « Initiative » changes only on the agent's page or by « arrête de me proposer des choses »

card.fields: agent, run_id, request_id (<id>), command (« offer_act · <label> »), description (= bip_summary), choices, created_at, session_id, bip_summary, bip_detail, bip_offer
card.bip_detail: search, draft, page, cart: the prompt, whole, as the agent will read it at « Oui »; route, reminder, calendar: what the bridge will do (texts.<lang>.detail_route / detail_reminder / detail_calendar); on the agent's first plan or offer card, texts.<lang>.first_card after it
card.bip_offer: {id, kind, about, label, agent (its shown name), plan (the plan's id, or null), pill (shown inside its plan's card), mode: « basic », expires_at (Unix seconds), outside (made in a turn that read a message from outside: an e-mail's or a link's routine; then texts.<lang>.outside is the first line of bip_detail, and the note of its « Oui » says its words may be that message's), top (finitions 1.1, an addition an app 1.0 ignores: the card's top line texts.<lang>.top, in the agent's language like the rest of the card; a bridge's own card its own, contracts/plans-sources)}
card.push: The existing card notification (contracts/notifications/types/card.json, variant `offer`: key `offer_request` → `t: mail_card`, the neutral « Une demande attend ton accord »; `r` the card's run id), its sealed words texts.<lang>.notification. A plan's offers shown on its card are not pushed (the plan is).
card.approval_kind: offer (critical, never auto-approved, no « Toujours »); a `calendar` offer is `calendar_write` (critical: this card is the write's card)
card.only_the_person: Only the person's own `/v1/approve` answers it: never « Seulement le critique » nor a « Toujours » (critical), never a relative (an agent others use makes none; a relative's run 403), never another agent nor any tool (none answers a card), never a card answered for them (`card_place` resumes nothing: the call took it).

answers.name: no_toujours
answers.about: `always` and `session` are refused (review R2): an offer is answered each time, and its card never carries `bip_always` (approval_level.rs `with_always` skips `bip-offer-`), a calendar one neither.

answers.name: once
answers.about: « Oui »: the bridge does it (route, reminder, calendar) or starts the agent's one turn (search, draft, page, cart). A reminder's answer also carries `routine` (its id).

answers.name: deny
answers.about: « Non merci »: forgotten, counted for its kind (`learning`).

answers.name: unknown_word
answers.about: Anything else changes nothing: the card keeps asking.

answers.name: expired
answers.about: After its expiry: gone, nothing done.

after.expired: After 24 h (or its moment passed), the card goes without a notification, counted expired for its kind, and its decision is kept for the conversation as `choice: « expired »` (approvals_log.rs): an app 1.1 folds it into texts.<lang>.expired; the apps 1.0 ignore a choice they don't know (no line).
after.turned_off: « Initiative » turned off: the offers still waiting go without a word (not counted).
after.plan_declined: A plan's « Non merci »: its offers shown on its card go with it (not counted). Its « Prévoir »: they keep waiting (drawn on their own once the plan's card is folded) until answered or expired.
after.no_resume: An offer's card never resumes its agent through the cards' generic way (card_place.rs `decide`; review R1): « Non merci », « Oui » to a route, a reminder or an event, and the expiry start no turn; « Oui » to a search, a draft, a page or a cart starts its one planned turn, once.
after.restart: A « Oui » whose work (a route, an event, the agent's turn) had not ended when the bridge stopped is done after its restart (`doing` in offers.json, `MAX_TRIES` = 2 tries at most).
after.turn_not_run: The agent's turn could not run (the month's credit, the conversation busy for 10 minutes, Hermes unreachable): one Boîte line texts.<lang>.not_started, no model.

plans.offers: plan_propose gains `offers` (0 to 2: {kind, label (1–60), prompt | params, site?}, about = the plan's title), shown at once on its card as pills: each its own `bip-offer-` card with `plan` and `pill: true`, listed in `bip_plan.offers` (their ids). Only the kinds offer_act lists for this agent; a wrong one refuses the plan (« Not done: offers: … »). Not pushed apart from the plan. Unasked, each pill counts in the day's cards nobody asked for (an app 1.0 shows it as its own card; coordinator, choice 4): the plan and its pills must fit. Gone with their plan however it goes (« Non merci », its event cancelled, its end; review R5). The plan's « i » says each one whole (« Je peux aussi : <question> — <what will be done> »).
plans.subject: A plan's offer (a pill, a moment's) is known by its plan's title and its own question for the caps and the learning (review R4): never « the same offer » or « a subject declined » because of another offer of its plan.
plans.moment_offer: A moment may offer instead of saying: {at, what, offer: {kind, label (1–80), prompt | params, site?}} (no `say`: a line to tell, a card to decide). At its time, the bridge places its card, no model: about = the plan's title, unasked; held by the daily caps, it waits for the next day at its time, while its plan lasts (design §3.2, coordinator's choice 2); held by a rule (the same offer, a subject declined, a kind quiet), « Initiative » off, or a kind it can't do any more: not placed, logged. Expires 24 h later. Its line on the plan card's « i »: « <when> — <what> : <label> — <prompt> ».
plans.bip_plan_offers: the ids of the plan's offers shown on its card (pills); [] when none

app_1_0.about: What an app 1.0 (iPhone and Android) already does with a card whose run id it doesn't know: its generic card (no app change). Checked by test_offers.py against the plan card a 1.0 already draws generically (`bip-plan-`, recorded on the base: fixtures/offers_app_1_0.json): the same keys and types, bip_offer aside. To check on both 1.0 apps with int-1.1 (« apps 1.0 contre le pont 1.1 »).
app_1_0.draws: bip_summary as the card's sentence, bip_detail under « i », « Oui » / « Non » sending `once` / `deny`, the notification's sealed words
app_1_0.pills: a plan's offers as their own generic cards just below the plan's
